import pytest from target import unescapeHTML @pytest.mark.parametrize( "input_str,expected", [ # Normal entities should be unescaped ("Fish & Chips", "Fish & Chips"), ("A < B > C", "A < B > C"), (""Hello"", '"Hello"'), # Multiple entities in one string ("<div>Hello & welcome</div>", "
Hello & welcome
"), # Entities with surrounding text ("Start©End", "Start©End"), ], ) def test_normal_entities_unescaped(input_str, expected): assert unescapeHTML(input_str) == expected @pytest.mark.parametrize( "input_str", [ # Entity containing an extra '&' should NOT be transformed "Bad &foo&bar; test", "Mixed & and &foo&bar; together", "Edge case: &abc&def; remains", "Multiple &foo&bar; &baz; entities", ], ) def test_malformed_entities_unchanged(input_str): # The function should leave the string unchanged because the old regex # would not match entities that contain an extra '&' before the terminating ';'. assert unescapeHTML(input_str) == input_str def test_none_input(): assert unescapeHTML(None) is None def test_type_assertion(): with pytest.raises(AssertionError): unescapeHTML(123) # not a string
